messages:
auditor_jane: Hi team — auditor here. Need a chain-of-custody and timeline for the KMS rotation that was done around the CVE-2025-xxxx triage. Specifically: which key was rotated, who initiated it (ticket/PR), RBAC changes around the same window, and the audit logs proving no emergency key material was created.

sec_eng_mike: Hi Jane — good catch. I'm pulling CloudTrail + k8s audit events now. Quick summary: CMK arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/cmk-0a1b2c3d was rotated 2025-06-12T03:21:45Z. Rotation was done by infra-rotations-bot (GitHub Actions) after vuln triage. I'll paste evidence and commands below.

infra_alyssa: Assembling an artifacts bundle (cloudtrail csv, k8s audit snippets, rolebinding exports, s3 lifecycle). ETA ~2h. Will include sha256 sums and a presigned S3 link. Also looping in @sec_manager_omar for approval for redaction.

sec_manager_omar: :thumbsup: Please include PR/commit link and the ticket ID. I'll review redaction before we hand off anything externally.

auditor_jane: Need PR link + ticket number that prompted rotation, and a concise manifest showing what files will be included. Also please confirm whether any pods were restarted or incapacitated during the rotation.

sec_eng_mike: Command I used to locate rotation events (for transparency):
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/cmk-0a1b2c3d --start-time 2025-06-10T00:00:00Z --end-time 2025-06-14T00:00:00Z
```
Result excerpt: `eventTime: 2025-06-12T03:21:45Z, eventName: RotateKey, userIdentity: infra-rotations-bot, requestParameters: {source: GitHubActions}`

infra_alyssa: Rotation PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/commit/abc123def. RBAC change: added RoleBinding `redwood-model-svc` -> ClusterRole `inference-runner` on 2025-06-12T03:15:02Z. I'll export `kubectl get rolebinding -o yaml` and k8s audit logs for that window.

sec_eng_mike: k8s audit snippet (sanitized):
```
{"kind":"RoleBinding","metadata":{"name":"redwood-model-svc","namespace":"model-serving"},"user":"ops-github-app[bot]","verb":"create","timestamp":"2025-06-12T03:15:02Z"}
```

oncall_bot: [deploy-bot] alert: deploy-2025-06-12 rotated CMK `cmk-0a1b2c3d` for prod-model-serving; no error events detected.

auditor_jane: Good. Another control question: how is key material accessed by the runtime? Is this envelope encryption with CMK only for DEK wrapping? Who can call Decrypt/GenerateDataKey? Need policy/principals.

sec_manager_omar: We use envelope encryption. CMK is HSM-backed in AWS KMS (no plaintext key material stored). Data keys (DEKs) are generated on demand via GenerateDataKey and encrypted under the CMK. Current allowed principals: `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/inference-runner`, `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ops-runner`, `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/infra-rotations-bot`. We'll export the key policy + IAM principal list.

auditor_jane: Need retention proof too — SOC control requires 12 months retention for relevant audit trails (CloudTrail, k8s audit, KMS logs). Please include lifecycle configuration and retention docs.

infra_alyssa: CloudTrail logs are stored in s3://redwood-audit-logs with lifecycle rule `Expire: 400 days`. Splunk (forwarding) retention policy is configured at 14 months. I'll export `s3-lifecycle.json` and Splunk retention screenshot.

sec_eng_mike: One more cross-check: ticket #T-4571 was opened 2025-06-11 regarding the CVE; vuln triage notes show rotation scheduled as precaution. @vuln_triage_eli can confirm timeline.

vuln_triage_eli: Confirmed. T-4571 created 2025-06-11 18:12 UTC. Summary: CVE-2025-xxxx — low confidence of key leakage; rotation scheduled 2025-06-12 to reduce blast radius. No emergency escalation was performed. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/T-4571

auditor_jane: Critical ask: confirm there were NO CreateGrant or CreateKeyMaterial events in CloudTrail during the rotation window (2025-06-11 -> 2025-06-13). Those would indicate emergency-access key creation.

sec_eng_mike: I ran filters: `eventName in (CreateGrant, CreateKeyMaterial, ImportKeyMaterial)` — zero results between 2025-06-11T00:00 and 2025-06-13T00:00. Will include the CloudTrail filter output as CSV.

auditor_jane: Ok please bundle the following artifacts and sign with sec-team GPG key: cloudtrail-rotation-window.csv, kms-key-policy.txt, rolebinding-export.json, s3-lifecycle.json, rotation-pr-abc123.patch, ticket-T-4571.pdf, sha256sums.txt. Provide presigned S3 link and add an entry to the evidence tracker. Also include contact list for chain-of-custody (names + emails).

sec_manager_omar: Understood. We'll prepare the bundle and redact any PII. Delivery method: presigned S3 link + entry in internal evidence tracker (https://jira.redwood/evidence). ETA EOD 2025-06-12.

auditor_jane: Thanks — I'll review when it's up. One follow-up after I review: may request raw CloudTrail events for a narrower time window.

sec_eng_mike: Noted. Quick note for the record: rotation was automated and tied to the infra-rotations-bot GitHub Actions run triggered by the vuln triage Jenkins job. No manual KMS console operations.

auditor_jane: That's perfect. Marking this thread as partial-fulfilled. I will follow up after bundle review. Thanks everyone :clap:
